title: Genshin Build Planner
description: gbp app, usage and VPS host metrics scraped through a Cloudflare Tunnel (see monitoring/README.md).

panels.title: Probe
panels.description: HTTPS probe of /api/health and / from home.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Image version (git tag) reported by gbp_build_info.

panels.title: Active users (7d)
panels.description: Users who created or edited a plan record in the last 7 days.

panels.title: Users
panels.description: Registered and email-verified users over time.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct users with a plan record created or edited within the window (1d ≈ DAU, 7d ≈ WAU, 30d ≈ MAU). Deleted records don't count.

panels.title: New users
panels.description: Users registered within the trailing window.

panels.title: Character plans per user
panels.description: How many users have up to N character plans (non-cumulative; the 0 bar is users without plans).

panels.title: Plans per user
panels.description: Character plans per user. The median is interpolated inside histogram buckets.

panels.title: Plan edits
panels.description: Created, updated and deleted plan records per interval, by collection.

panels.title: Logins and sign-ups
panels.description: Successful authentications by method (refresh = a returning session) and new accounts.

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Per matched route over the dashboard time range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (method, route, le) (increase(gbp_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="gbp", instance="$instance"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Plan saves (/api/batch)
panels.description: Every plan edit is sent as one batch request. Anything but 200 means lost edits.

panels.title: Disk
panels.description: Usage of the disk filesystems; pb_data lives on one of them.

targets.expr: 1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node", instance="$instance", fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs|f2fs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node", instance="$instance", fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs|f2fs"}

panels.title: Probe latency
panels.description: Full HTTPS round trip of the probe, including DNS and TLS.

panels.title: Log entries
panels.description: Warnings and errors the app logged, by kind (request = a failed request). Read the entries in the PocketBase logs (dashboard link above), kept for 5 days.
